tasks.label: build (windows mingw)
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build-win -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-win -j8 && copy /Y build-win\TrayIconGuard.exe dist\

tasks.label: ui-test screenshots (wine)
tasks.command: for p in dashboard icons guard appearance backups activity about; do xvfb-run -a wine dist/TrayIconGuard.exe --ui-test $p; done
